title: Beyond the Raw Waveform: Fusing Visual Representations of EDA for Stress Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.22095v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electrodermal activity (EDA) is widely used in automatic stress detection, yet most pipelines treat it only as a raw one-dimensional waveform. This study examines whether complementary visual representations of EDA provide useful information for stress classification and whether their fusion im- proves recognition performance. Six image-based representations are derived from each EDA recording: an unwrapped short-time Fourier transform (STFT) phase spectrogram, an instantaneous-frequency map computed from that phase, a power spectral density (PSD) spectrogram, a continuous wavelet transform scalogram, a recurrence plot, and a rendered waveform trace. The selected representations are stacked as channels of a single multichannel input, together with the raw waveform, and processed by a shared asymmetric-attention architecture. translated_title: 超越原始波形：融合EDA的视觉表示用于压力检测
translated_abstract: 皮肤电活动（EDA）被广泛应用于自动压力检测，然而大多数处理流程仅将其视为原始的一维波形。本研究探讨了EDA的互补视觉表示是否能为压力分类提供有用信息，以及它们的融合能否提升识别性能。研究从每条EDA记录中提取六种基于图像的表示：解缠短时傅里叶变换（STFT）相位谱图、由该相位计算的瞬时频率图、功率谱密度（PSD）谱图、连续小波变换尺度图、递归图以及渲染的波形轨迹图。所选的表示与原始波形一起被堆叠为单个多通道输入，并由共享的非对称注意力架构进行处理。在包含58名受试者的压力数据集上的实验表明，表示融合方法优于仅使用原始波形的方法。
tldr: 该研究将EDA信号的六种视觉表示（如STFT相位谱图、小波尺度图、递归图等）与原始波形融合为多通道输入，通过非对称注意力架构显著提升了压力检测性能。
en_tdlr: This study fuses six visual representations of EDA signals (such as STFT phase spectrograms, wavelet scalograms, and recurrence plots) with the raw waveform as multichannel inputs, improving stress detection performance through an asymmetric-attention architecture.
